text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (February 6, 2024) for 2350 Dundas Street West, 1907A.

Confirmed the Property Standards Order (February 6, 2024) for 2350 Dundas Street West, 1907A, Folder Number: 24 107215 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to July 18, 2024.
